An '''iknayid''' was a [[Sentience/Legends|non-sentient]] [[Spider/Legends|arachnid]] [[Species/Legends|species]] that was native to the [[Swamp/Legends|swamps]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Zakuul]].<ref name="KOTFE" /> Several taxidermized iknayids were displayed at the [[Royal Hunting Lodge]] of [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]] around [[3627 BBY]].<ref name="onderon">{{TORcite|exp=ons|type=location|[[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]]}}</ref>

Iknayid could be trained and were used in [[Arena Grand|gladiator fights]] on [[Zakuul]].<ref name="KOTFE" />
